protocol:
1. Put on blue nitrile gloves and arrange the horizontal agarose gel electrophoresis chambers, gel trays, buffer-filled tanks, power supply leads, micropipettes, tip boxes, and microcentrifuge tubes on the bench.

2. Position the agarose gel tray inside the clear electrophoresis chamber and align the gel so the wells are accessible under the running buffer.

3. Check the electrophoresis chamber connections by handling the red and black electrode leads connected to the power supply; the power supply display reads “End.”

4. Wipe the bench or gloved hand with a tissue near the electrophoresis chambers to clear liquid or debris before loading samples.

5. Pick up an adjustable micropipette and attach a disposable pipette tip from the tip box.

6. Open a microcentrifuge tube containing a purple sample/loading-dye mixture and hold it near the electrophoresis chamber.

7. Aspirate the purple sample/loading-dye mixture into the pipette tip using the micropipette.

8. Insert the pipette tip into a well of the submerged agarose gel and dispense the purple sample/loading-dye mixture into the well.

9. Eject the used pipette tip into the red waste container.

10. Attach a fresh disposable pipette tip to the micropipette from the tip box.

11. Aspirate another aliquot of purple sample/loading-dye mixture from a microcentrifuge tube.

12. Load the purple sample/loading-dye mixture into another well of the submerged agarose gel with the micropipette.

13. Reconnect and secure the electrophoresis chamber lead to the chamber terminal connected to the power supply after sample loading.
